newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Steel to raise steel sheet prices.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Steel to raise steel sheet prices.

text.p: Nippon Steel Corp said on Wednesday it would raise the price of its steel sheets for use in cars and home appliances from next month.
The price for cold- and hot-rolled sheets will go up by 3,000 yen and by 4,000 yen for coated steel sheets, effective from delivery in April and May, a Nippon Steel spokesman said.
The company would not reveal the actual prices charged to large-lot users, saying these are set through individual negotiations.
The increase reflects firm wholesale steel prices caused by strong demand, particularly from car makers, industry sources said.
Kawasaki Steel may also increase its prices, a Kawasaki spokesman said.
Other steelmakers are expected to follow suit, industry sources said.
They said steelmakers want to boost prices partly because of higher costs for imported raw materials caused by the weaker yen.
